messages.subject: Differences in unite function w/ v0.9.1 update?
parts:
Altuna,

I see in the documentation that in v0.9.1 the "unite() function takes less time due to use of data.table::merge."

I was wondering if anything else about the function has changed, by chance? 

I'm getting many fewer CpG sites now for analysis than I was before with the same methylRawList as input and (from what I can tell) the same line of code:
meth=unite(myobj, destrand=TRUE). 

I know that this isn't the case with the example data provided, but I'm at a loss at this point. (I'm sure it's an issue in my cod and something I did previously but can't find it...andI can't seem to figure it out...so I figured I'd ask just in case I'm missing something about the update.)

Thanks!
Shannon

By the way, I completely understand if you don't have any suggestions on this one!
